course.flowInput: I was given a standard specification: to create and make a course catalog (search, filters, pagination) using a pure HTML/SCSS/Vanilla JS stack. My goal was to transform it from a test task into an architecturally sound and production-ready project.
course.flowProcess:
Frontend Architecture: Implemented all logic as a pure ES6 CourseCatalog class with clear separation of responsibilities (BEM methodology for styles, cacheDOM, render, handleEvent for logic). This ensures clean, testable code.

Performance and UI: Achieved Sub-50KB asset size. Integrated Live Search with Debounce (300ms) and pagination with smooth appearance (CSS-cascade animation) for optimal UX.

Accessibility (A11y): Full compliance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA (ARIA, focus management, semantic HTML), which is a critical requirement for modern systems.

Testing: Configured Jest with >70% coverage (Unit, E2E), ensuring reliability of all business logic (filtering, search, pagination).

DevOps & Deployment: Implemented GitHub Actions CI/CD for automatic execution of linters/tests and build. Project is containerized in Docker with Nginx for secure and optimized deployment.
course.flowOutput: I created a Production-Ready catalog with an ideal Lighthouse Score, a reliable Vanilla JS architecture, and full automation. This project demonstrates that I can independently take responsibility for the entire development cycle: from pixel-perfect layout and architecture to testing, optimization, and deployment.

metrics.label: Production-Ready
metrics.description: Vanilla JS Class, WCAG AA, CI/CD, Docker

lumi.flowInput: I decided to create my own Task Manager (Lumi). I didn't want any compromises: it should be fast, work offline, and be maximally secure (project made by me, from start to finish).
lumi.flowProcess:
Architecture and Stack: Pure React 18, TypeScript, Vite. Backend and Realtime fully on Supabase.

Performance: I achieved instant response (Optimistic UI) and implemented PWA with smart caching (NetworkFirst for API).

Security: Configured Row Level Security (RLS) in PostgreSQL to ensure each user sees only their data. All incoming data is strictly validated on the client through Zod.

Reliability: All errors are tracked in real time via Sentry. Vercel configuration includes necessary Security Headers (X-XSS-Protection, X-Frame-Options).

DevOps: Implemented Husky and Commitlint for enforced commit convention.
lumi.flowOutput: I created a full-featured PWA application that works like native. This is a high-performance product with a secure API layer and offline capability, completely designed and implemented by me alone.

metrics.label: Performance
metrics.description: Instant response with Rollback on errors

tot.flowInput: Create a reference project with a comprehensive development plan and complete design system.
tot.flowProcess: This project is a reference for professional design. The key feature is the comprehensive Plan.md with 1000+ lines, which serves as the project's 'bible'. It details a 13-stage development plan (45-65 days), 3-part architecture (Landing, Auth, Platform) and complete design system: from colors and responsive typography (fonts TT Travels Next / Open Sans) to breakpoints (1240/576/360px). Stack - Vue 3 + TypeScript + Composition API + Pinia + Vue Router. Tailwind CSS was chosen for UI, allowing for rapid custom design implementation. Currently implemented is the 'HomePage' (10 sections) that strictly follows the plan: uses BaseButton from components/common, correctly applies fonts (font-tt-travels) and Tailwind classes.
tot.flowOutput: Fully functional homepage with 10 sections, following all architectural principles and design system described in the plan.

yokai.flowInput: Develop a SPA dashboard for real-time monitoring of spiritual anomalies (yokai). Operators should see energy spikes and send "cleaning squads". Requirements: strict Feature-Sliced Design, SSE for live updates, optimistic updates with 30% error probability, Docker deployment.
yokai.flowProcess:
Architecture: Strict Feature-Sliced Design with isolated layers (app/pages/widgets/features/entities/shared). Each slice is independent — new features can be added without refactoring.

Real-Time: Server-Sent Events instead of WebSocket for one-way stream. Every 5 seconds a random yokai changes threat level. Integration with React Query cache — UI updates instantly without re-fetching.

State Management: TanStack Query with Optimistic Updates. UI changes before server response, automatic rollback on error (30% probability). Pattern from Trello/Linear.

Type Safety: TypeScript strict mode + Zod for runtime validation of all API inputs/outputs. Schemas document contracts and protect against invalid data.

Testing & CI/CD: Test Pyramid (Jest + Playwright), 67% coverage. GitHub Actions pipeline: lint → test → build → e2e. Husky hooks for commitlint and lint-staged.

DevOps: Docker Compose for one-command deployment. Nginx for production-ready serving.
yokai.flowOutput: Production-ready dashboard with real-time SSE, reliable FSD architecture, automated testing and complete CI/CD cycle. The project demonstrates understanding of enterprise patterns: from optimistic updates to deployment automation. Above and beyond: Full test coverage (unit/integration/e2e), CI/CD pipeline with quality gates, Architecture documentation (docs/), Git hooks for code quality.

moviecatalog.flowInput: Develop a movie catalog SPA with search by title, category filtering, and detailed viewing. Requirements: responsive layout, semantic markup, error handling, performance optimization, animations. A test assignment for a Junior Frontend Developer position.
moviecatalog.flowProcess:
Architecture: Feature-based structure with division into layers (components/features/entities/shared). React 18 + TypeScript for type safety, React Router for navigation between pages.

UI/UX: Tailwind CSS for utility-first approach, Framer Motion for smooth animations of cards and modal windows. Implemented dark/light theme with toggle and localStorage persistence.

State & Performance:
- Debounced search (300ms) through custom hook for query optimization
- Lazy loading of images with loading="lazy"
- Code splitting via React.lazy for detailed page
- Pagination with "Load More" instead of infinite scroll

Type Safety: TypeScript strict mode + typing of all props and state. Interfaces for Movie, FilterCategory, Theme.

Testing & Quality:
- Vitest + React Testing Library
- 87% test coverage (unit + integration tests)
- Tests for all components and hooks
- ESLint + TypeScript for code quality
moviecatalog.flowOutput:
Production-ready movie catalog with responsive design, dark theme, debounced search, categorical filtering and detailed pages. The project demonstrates understanding of React ecosystem, performance optimization and best practices for testing.

Above and beyond (+50%):
- Modal window with movie details
- Detailed page with routing
- Dark/Light theme switcher
- 87% test coverage (was not required)
- Skeleton loaders for UX
- Scroll to top button
